presentation.fr: Dernier volet de la trilogie d'<ph id='ellul'>Ellul</ph> : il y dénonce le discours qui entoure la technique, publicité, promesses et prospective, et qui en masque les coûts, les risques et l'imprévisibilité.
presentation.en: The last part of <ph id='ellul'>Ellul</ph>'s trilogy: he denounces the discourse that surrounds technology, advertising, promises and forecasting, which masks its costs, its risks and its unpredictability.
